title: Amazing show from start...
text:
Amazing show from start to finish !  Very entertaining - extremely talented musicians and dancers.
Highly recommend this tour !
author: Raymond_M

title: Beautiful theatre
text:
The  Palau de la Musica is a beautiful theatre both on the outside and inside. The guitar playing was fantastic along with the Flamenco dancing.

I wouldn’t recommend booking with TripAdvisor as the give you terrible seats up at the top and in back
author: Paterjo

title: It was a great family...
text: It was a great family experience. It was funny and the guitar playing and flamenco dancing was phenomenal.
author: Esther_L

title: Amazing hall and performance!
text: First of all, the UNESCO Heritage site music hall is an experience in itself. The architecture, artistic design, and decor is a marvel to witness. The three guitarists were masters of their craft and even weaved in some humor during the 1:45 minute show. Then there's the Flemenco dancers, WOW! Simply put, it's an amazing show in a world class hall. Highly recommend!
author: A3289GImarkf

title: Spectacular
text: Spectacular show and the theater is incredible. It’s worth a ticket. One thing I will say is we had a very difficult time finding the place since Tripadvisor does not have their address on their website or on your admission ticket. this did present a problem. But once we found the place, it was all worthwhile. Although we were a little late.
author: deadh

title: A memorable experience
text: Excellent show in a magnificent venue.  Guitarists and dancers equally impressive
author: lorrainelG9144ZT

title: More than I imagined...amazing show!
text: Amazing show...the musicians were incredible and the dancers lit up the stage.
author: avondistrict1565

title: Perfection!
text: Beautiful venue, talented musicians & dancers.  Perfect!
author: kellydU4947CU

title: Great musical show
text: The guitar players were definitely the star of the show, but the combinations of different guitar players with flamenco dancers was surprisingly fresh.  We went to the show to see something nice and ended feeling that this was one of the best things we saw in Barcelona.  Highly recommended.
author: Russell_P

title: A Magical Night !
text: The venue (Palau de la Musica) was stunning and the show was so enjoyable. The guitarists are gifted musicians and the dancers were well integrated into several numbers. I feel fortunate to have been able to book this show during my brief time in Barcelona. I recommends it highly!
author: Rich_N
